findings.title: Raw SQL String Concatenation in User Search
findings.description: The search endpoint directly interpolates unsanitized user query parameter into an SQL SELECT statement.
findings.code_snippet:
query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = '{search_query}'"
cursor.execute(query)
results = cursor.fetchall()
findings.remediation_guidance: Use parameterized queries: cursor.execute('SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = %s', (search_query,))

evidence_metadata.line_text: query = f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = '{search_query}'"

findings.title: Untrusted Shell Execution in Diagnostic Utility
findings.description: Diagnostic endpoint invokes os.system using unescaped host IP parameter.
findings.remediation_guidance: Use subprocess.run(['ping', '-c', '1', host_ip], shell=False) with strict IP address validation.

findings.title: Hardcoded JWT Secret Token in Authentication Module
findings.description: Authentication signing secret key is directly committed in source code instead of environment variables.
findings.remediation_guidance: Load JWT secret using os.environ.get('JWT_SECRET') and store actual keys in a secure secret manager.
